coverage: All 20 model choices plus INT_MIN and INT_MAX model IDs; clamped model-name lookup.
Fourteen internal/host rate pairs, including 8 kHz through 1.536 MHz, host greater than internal, below-minimum and negative/zero rates, DBL_MAX, NaN and positive/negative infinity.

Nine onset tuples covering MIDI 0 and 127, fractional and middle notes, velocity 0 and 1, brightness 0 and 1, decay .25 and 4, size .5 and 2.5, FLT_MAX and its negative, NaN and infinities. Seeds 0, UINT32_MAX and a fixed nonzero seed.

Tick frequencies from tiny positive values to FLT_MAX plus zero, negative, NaN and infinities; invalid-frequency silence is asserted. Brightness and pressure include legal endpoints, out-of-range finite values and nonfinite values.
Filter cutoff/Q endpoints, huge positive and negative values, NaN/infinities, rapid bypass changes and explicit reset/re-prepare.
120 valid-rate/model cases run for 4097 samples, crossing the 2048-sample mode normalization and coefficient-refresh boundaries.

120 outgoing body/filter value-copy cases remain exactly equal to independent references after the original objects are reset, prepared and assigned another note. Frozen-filter snapshots are exercised.

limitations: LeakSanitizer scanning was disabled with detect_leaks=0 because review31 established that leak scanning aborts under this runner's ptrace environment. The retained prior review contains that failed run. This worker did not rerun leak scanning or claim a leak-detection pass.
AddressSanitizer memory instrumentation and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer checks remained enabled, as verified by the two independently executed deliberate-fault controls.
The complete prior harness is unchanged; no new boundary coverage is claimed beyond its recorded matrix. The dedicated final piano continuity regressions remain in reviews34 and37.
This standalone test does not measure engine or host-wrapper real-time behavior, native ABI compatibility, all allocation activity, or acoustic/perceptual equivalence.
